title: fix(release): the duplicate-Release audit counts distinct ids, so a Release the moving list serves twice is one
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92PbDQRKbS6saKBBMa9Dg8A)_

Fixes #26552

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发版脚本的「重复 Release」审计改成按 Release id 去重，同一个 id 被翻页列两次只算一个；列表漏掉的 tag 先按 tag 重读一次再判「未核实」。
- 为什么改：18.2.0 补发 run 40464600678 里 `@object-ui/fields@18.2.0` 的同一个 id 425135424 被列了两次，审计报「2 个 Release」、surplus 列表为空，发布本身完整却红了。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` 一个文件，不动工作流；真正两个不同 id 的重复照旧报错（自测有控制行）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` 的 `auditDuplicateReleases`（按 id 记账与 by-tag 重读），其次 `describeDuplicates`，再看自测第 16 组。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/release-github-releases.mjs --self-test`，预期一行 `✓ … 114 assertions`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`scripts/release-github-releases.mjs` only, plus its `--self-test`.

- `auditDuplicateReleases` keys each tag's rows by `rel.id`. A tag is a duplicate only when it carries two distinct ids. The same id served on two offset pages is one Release, counted in a new `rowsServedTwice` field.
- When the walk completed, a tag no page showed is re-read through `findByTag` before it is called unseen. A Release the by-tag endpoint answers goes into a new `foundByTag` field instead of `unseen`. A walk that stopped at its page cap re-reads nothing, because its unseen tags may sit, twins included, on pages it never read.
- `describeDuplicates` collapses repeated ids itself and skips an entry with fewer than two distinct ids, so it can never print an empty surplus list or a repeated "This run created" id. It also returns `notes`: a plain log line (not a warning) when the list moved under the walk. `main` prints the notes before the warnings.
- The stub client gains a `listMoves` hook that reshapes the newest-first list just before a page is cut from it.

## Why

Release run 40464600678 (job 122058101982, the 18.2.0 `force: true` repair) published 110 of 110 packages and still exited 1:

```
##[error]@object-ui/fields@18.2.0 has 2 GitHub Releases: 425135424 (no assets), 425135424 (no assets). … the other(s), , are the surplus. This run created 425135424, 425135424 …
##[warning]… 1 tag(s) this run released never appeared in it (@object-ui/types@18.2.0) …
```

All of one version's Releases carry the same tag date, so their order among themselves is not stable from one list request to the next, and a create pushes every row down. Between two offset page reads one row was served twice and another on no page. The audit pushed every matching row without keying on the id.

## Tests

New battery `16. A list that moves between page reads is one Release per id` (11 cases, pinned in `SELF_TEST_BATTERIES`; the roster floor is raised 15 to 16):

- Positive control: the swap fixture really serves one id on pages 1 and 2 and one id on neither.
- A tie-order swap at the page boundary gives 0 duplicates and 0 unseen. `rowsServedTwice` is 1, `foundByTag` names the hidden tag, there are no errors or warnings, and there is one note.
- A create landing at the head between two reads gives 0 duplicates, 0 unseen, 0 found by tag and 1 repeated row.
- Control: a real two-id pair under the same swap is still one ERROR, listing `9003 (no assets), 9004 (no assets)`, with the non-empty surplus `9004` and `This run created 9004:`.
- The literal 40464600678 audit shape (one id twice, created twice) handed to `describeDuplicates` gives no error, no warning and no empty-surplus text.
- A capped walk sends no by-tag read for its unread tags, and they stay UNVERIFIED.

Batteries 1–15 are unchanged. Battery 14's real-pair, pre-existing-pair, capped and never-appeared cases all still hold.

No ablation: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` excludes scripts from one-time ablations. Battery 16's positive control shows the fixture really moves.

## Acceptance notes

- The by-tag re-read proves that a hidden tag's Release exists. It cannot prove that no second Release on that tag was hidden by the same move. That limit belongs to any walk over a list whose tie order is unstable, and the note line says the list moved.
- `skip-changeset`: the diff touches only a repo-internal release tool. No package ships it.
